fields.label: Default Label Type
fields.description: NOT YET USED: Select the default label type to be used when printing labels.

fields.label: WebSocket Address
fields.description: Enter the full address (URL) of the WebSocket server used by the scanner for label printing. The server should send data in the format: BARCODE:<barcode_value>.

fields.label: TTS API Key
fields.description: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech API service key

fields.label: Package/Bag Item for Weighted Items
fields.description: Item used for packaging or bagging weighted items. (single-use bag fee)

fields.label: Package Item Text
fields.description: This text is added under the price of weighted item.

fields.label: Deposit Item Text
fields.description: This text is added under the price if deposit_package_count > 0.

fields.label: Deposit Item Price
fields.description: Multiplier to apply to the deposit item price when calculating the total deposit amount
